title: Review Aftersales Requests
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /return_refund/202609/aftersales/review

Method: [POST]

Function Description

API used to review (approve, reject, or offer alternatives to) a buyer's return request.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
aftersales_request_decisions []object N Decisions to apply to aftersales requests.
^request_id string Y 4035319218955782461 Identifies the object upon which this decision is made.
^request_id_type string N AFTERSALES Type of identifier provided in request_id.
Possible values:
  • AFTERSALES
  • RMA | ^line_item_decisions |[]object |Y | |Decisions applied at the line item level. One SKU may only have one decision, so all line items (corresponding to that same SKU) should fall under the same decision object. Different line item decisions for the same SKU will soon be supported in the future. | ^^line_items |[]object |Y | |Line items for which this decision applies. Decision details apply to each line item individually (e.g. a partial refund amount of $1.00 for 3 line items will result in a total partial refund amount of $3.00). | ^^^return_line_item_id |string |Y |4035227657962164811 |Unique identifier for this item in the return. In the case of virtual bundle, this corresponds to the id of the original parent item bundle. | ^^^sub_return_line_item_id |string |N |4035227657962164815 |Unique identifier for this item in the return. In the case of virtual bundle, this corresponds to the id of the current child item being returned. | ^^action |string |Y |APPROVE_REQUEST |Action/decision to be applied. Possible values:
  • APPROVE_REQUEST
  • APPROVE_RETURN_PACKAGE
  • REJECT_REQUEST
  • REJECT_RETURN_PACKAGE
  • REFUND_INSTEAD
  • OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND
  • OFFER_PARTIAL_REFUND_AFTER_RECEIVING_PKG | ^^alternative_solution_details |object |N | |Details for an alternative resolution (if applicable). | ^^^partial_refund_amount |string |N |12.34 |Proposed refund amount. | ^^^currency |string |N |USD |Currency of the refund amount (ISO 4217). Must match the currency of the forward order. | ^^reason |object |N | |To justify the action/decision (generally required for rejection). | ^^^reason_id |string |N |seller_reject_apply_package_has_not_exceeded_estimated_delivery_time |Seller's reason for rejecting the aftersales request. Use the Get Review Decision endpoint to retrieve the currently available rejection options for the same request, and submit the returned rejection reason name in this field. Note: The available decisions and rejection reasons can change depending on the current request status, so fetch eligibility again before calling this API. | ^^^text |string |N |I have reached an agreement with the buyer |Additional explanation for the decision. | ^^^media |object |N | |Supporting evidence (such as images). | ^^^^uri |string |N |tos-maliva-i-o3syd03w52-us/57a1c8908fe74572861ea5e50887d8d1 |Image URI obtained from the Upload Product Image API. | ^^^^mime_type |string |N |image/png |MIME type of the media (such as image/jpeg). | ^action_unix_time |int |N |1774486592 |The timestamp at which the decision/action was made (in unix seconds). | ^idempotency_key |string |N |40b456b1-78e7-412d-9fe6-82181496e1bd&app_key=38abcd |The idempotency key is a unique value generated by the client which the server uses to recognize the same request. How you create unique keys is up to you, but we suggest using UUIDs, or another random string with enough entropy to avoid collisions. Idempotency keys can be up to 255 characters long. |

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^errors []object Lists errors for partially failed requests. For example, if a request reviews multiple orders or items and only some fail, individual error details are returned here.
IMPORTANT: Partial failures still return a top-level success code (0), so clients must also check this field to detect partial errors. For complete failures (e.g. validation errors), the top-level response code and message will indicate a failure, but this field will remain empty.
^^code string 98001004 Error code.
^^message string Invalid parameters. Please verify your input before retrying Error description.
